verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-4 diff remains correct and complete. The added self-tests exercise the production provider-capped scan with literal, distinct expectations and cover both outcomes of the enabled-account filter: an all-enabled-capped firing action and a partial-enabled-capped non-firing action. They independently pin the fire decision, enabled-only churn count, and reset hint, and the hostile non-enabled reset makes removal or bypass of the filter observable. Expectations are not derived from production constants or fixture transformations. The change is test-only, weakens no trust control, exposes no sensitive data, and contains no instruction-like injection. There are no review findings.
